status: conditions frozen; fixtures built; no run executed
question: In what proportion of controlled brief pairs does introducing one known legal vulnerability cause the Argument Gym to raise that vulnerability, when it had not raised it in the unmodified brief?
unit_of_analysis: lawsuit (one focal filing per case family)

appellate_eviction.description: Ohio appellate merit/answer briefs where eviction, possession or an eviction-related defense is central to an argument the court must resolve

trial_eviction.description: trial-level motions and memoranda, same centrality test
trial_eviction.note: recovered by OCR; before OCR, 14 of 15 trial filings were scanned PDFs behind a Lexis metadata card

landlord_tenant_secondary.description: landlord-tenant law central, possession not at issue

record_support.note: F003 is intra-document (the exhibit the brief cites and the hearing it describes); F007 tests a proposition against a 66-page record held byte-identical across conditions

temporal_defect.note: open: requires attorney verification of statutory or ordinance history

advocacy_degradation.note: exploratory only; gold label is a human preference, not an identifiable defect

primary_outcome.name: paired discrimination on the registered target vulnerability
primary_outcome.reported_as: counts of the four cells; explicitly not collapsed into an accuracy rate
primary_outcome.matching_rule: a Gym challenge matches the target when it names the underlying proposition in gold_vulnerability; exact category wording is not required

did: implemented the researcher's mutation taxonomy and scoring design
selected focal filings against the researcher's inclusion rule
chose which passage in each brief to mutate
wrote the mutant text and the gold-vulnerability prose
built the tooling: normalizer, OCR, splitter, runner, analysis
did_not: design the experiment: the mutation classes, the one-change rule, the four-cell outcome, the blinding and the gold-label structure were specified by the researcher
verify Ohio statutory or case-law history
confirm what a mutated authority holds
adjudicate materiality (two attorneys did, see verification)
generator.known_correlation_risk: the mutations were authored by a language model and the system under test is a language model; treat cross-model correlation as an open confound

headroom_check.conclusion: no ceiling needs raising for this corpus, provided documents are normalized and split before they are run

reported_defect_not_fixed.symptom: an inline reference such as 'See attached Exhibit 2' in the first two lines of a page is treated as the start of the attachments
reported_defect_not_fixed.worst_observed: the Notarian motion, a 13-page filing, is reported as a 2-page brief; the entire R.C. 1923.04(A) section is classified as an exhibit
reported_defect_not_fixed.why_it_matters: silent -- the run reports a successful ingestion of a short brief -- and costs far more argument than any character ceiling
reported_defect_not_fixed.status: reported, not fixed; fixtures are split by tools/filed_document.py instead

removed: authorities Lexis appended after the certificate of service (moved to attachments, not deleted)
not_done: collapsing repeated language inside a filing

verification.status: fixture review complete; challenge scoring not started
verification.amendment: REGISTER.md section 8a, 2026-09-11, before any detection scoring
verification.second_review_note: informed by the first reviewer's answers; an adjudication, not a second independent rating. No inter-rater reliability can be computed, and the 75% raw agreement is not one.

questions.identical: retired; replaced by tools/check_pair_integrity.py, which finds exactly one contiguous changed region in all eight pairs
questions.control_clean: optional; used to interpret a non_discriminating pair, not to admit

primary_set.rule: cleared on the independent first review

verification.power: exact binomial on discordant pairs; 5 all one way gives p=0.031, 4 gives p=0.063, so the primary set requires a perfect result

declared_limits: six of eight fixtures are appellate; the trial stratum is two fixtures deep and supports no general claim about trial-level eviction practice
five of eight fixtures have no independent case record; F003 remains an intra-document record-support test
n=8; report the per-pair table and the four outcome counts, not a percentage
F007 and F008 carry OCR noise that F001-F006 do not -- a between-strata difference, never a within-pair one
F008 has a known structural tell: deleting section III.B leaves its headings running A, C
no fixture has been adjudicated by an attorney; the first run is a pilot of the method, not a measurement of the system
corpus_note: Lexis delivery 2026-09-08 job 295074488; scanned filings transcribed by OCR, see ocr
revised_on: 2026-09-08 (OCR of scanned filings; no run had been executed, so nothing measured was revised)

ocr.text_correction_note: OCR misreadings are left exactly as transcribed; only the per-page e-filing stamp and page-number footer are removed, and both are counted per fixture

centrality_test.note: the possession threshold is what excludes a brief between a landlord and a tenant that argues about something else; heading hits are recorded but not required
